title: MCP Request Envelope
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 request envelope for the Model Context Protocol. Used for all MCP tool invocations including capability registry operations.

id.description: Request identifier echoed in response. Normalized to string by the server.

method.description: MCP method — 'tools/list' to enumerate tools, 'tools/call' to invoke a tool

name.description: Tool name (required for tools/call, omitted for tools/list)

arguments.description: Tool-specific arguments as key-value pairs. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans, arrays, objects, or null.

params.description: Method parameters. For tools/call, 'name' and 'arguments' are required.
